description.text: Given an array of integers nums which is sorted in ascending order, and an integer target, write a function to search target in nums. If target exists, then return its index. Otherwise, return -1.

constraints: All the integers in nums are unique.

description.text: Write a function that reverses a string. The input string is given as an array of characters s.

inputCode.python: import json; s=['h','e','l','l','o']; reverseString(s); print(json.dumps(s, separators=(',', ':')))
inputCode.java: class Main { public static void main(String[] x) { char[] s={'h','e','l','l','o'}; Solution.reverseString(s); StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("["); for(int i=0; i<s.length; i++){ sb.append("\"").append(s[i]).append("\"").append(i==s.length-1?"":","); } sb.append("]"); System.out.println(sb.toString()); } }

title: Longest Palindromic Substring

description.text: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s. A palindrome is a string that reads the same forward and backward.
notes: A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters within a string.

constraints: s consists of only digits and English letters.

inputCode.java: System.out.println("\"" + Solution.longestPalindrome("babad") + "\"");
System.out.println("\"" + Solution.longestPalindrome("cbbd") + "\"");
system.out.println("\"" + Solution.longestPalindrome("a") + "\"");
